content.short: Cryptosender is a multisender for batch-sending tokens and NFTs to many addresses in one transaction.
content.description: Cryptosender sends ERC-20 tokens, native coins and NFTs to thousands of addresses in batched transactions, saving gas and time for airdrops, payroll and distributions across more than 30 blockchains. Blockscout's Unichain and World Chain app marketplaces list it.
content.meta: Cryptosender batch-sends tokens and NFTs to many addresses across 30+ chains, including Unichain and World Chain.
